name: Pops, Blips & Text Appear
when_to_use: Text box, sticker, emoji or icon appears; bullet points or list items stack in; a stat number appears; a caption keyword is highlighted; thumbnail tiles pop onto a wall.

sounds.name: Digital Tonal Blip 01
sounds.desc: A 140 ms tonal digital blip with a quick decay; use when a stat or caption keyword appears.

sounds.name: Digital Tonal Blip 02
sounds.desc: A warmer, pure-toned 70 ms beep, the roundest in the set; use for list items stacking in or confirm taps.

sounds.name: Digital Tonal Blip 03
sounds.desc: A pure 165 ms tone that swells slightly; use when a HUD element or text card appears.

sounds.name: Bright Tonal Ping 01
sounds.desc: A clean, bright tonal ping of about 180 ms; use when a caption keyword highlights or a small icon appears.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Digital Tonal Blip 04
sounds.desc: A bright 90 ms tonal digital beep; use when a text box or icon appears.

sounds.name: Drop Tick Bright 01
sounds.desc: A quiet bright tonal tick; use as an item drops into place or a caption word is highlighted.

sounds.name: Low Sci-Fi Bloop 01
sounds.desc: A short, low tonal bloop under 0.3 s with a quick decay; use when a text box, icon or list item pops on screen.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.name: Low Sci-Fi Bloop 02
sounds.desc: A deep, near-mono tonal bloop of about 0.3 s; good for an icon or stat popping in with some weight.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.name: Low Tonal Blip 01
sounds.desc: A soft, low tonal bloop with a short decay. Good for a gentle toggle, a deselect or a subtle text-appear accent.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Minimal Soft Blip 01
sounds.desc: A soft, tonal 55 ms blip; use when a small text box or icon appears or a caption keyword highlights.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Minimal Soft Blip 02
sounds.desc: A soft tonal blip of about 100 ms, slightly brighter than 01; use for list items stacking in or small UI elements appearing.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Modern Tonal Blip 01
sounds.desc: A short mid-pitched tonal blip of about 110 ms; use for text boxes popping in or list items stacking.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Modern Tonal Blip 02
sounds.desc: A short mid-pitched tonal blip of about 125 ms; rotate with its siblings for stacking list items or text appearing.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Modern Tonal Blip 03
sounds.desc: A slightly brighter tonal blip of about 175 ms; use for a stat or icon appearing on screen.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Soft Sine Bloop 01
sounds.desc: A soft, dark, rounded bloop of about 135 ms; use for a gentle text appear or a list item stacking in.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Soft Sine Bloop 02
sounds.desc: A soft, dark, rounded bloop of about 145 ms, slightly lower than 01; use for gentle list items or icons appearing.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Soft Sine Bloop 03
sounds.desc: A soft rounded bloop of about 200 ms, the highest of the set; use for a gentle pop as text or a card appears.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Soft Synth Pluck 01
sounds.desc: A clean, tonal 100 ms synth pluck with a fast decay; use it under a caption word or a list item appearing.

sounds.name: Soft Synth Pluck 02
sounds.desc: A slightly longer, mellow tonal synth pluck at about 160 ms; use it for an icon, sticker or bullet point landing.

sounds.name: Tonal UI Blip 01
sounds.desc: A clean, mid-pitched tonal UI blip with a short decay. Works for a button confirm or a list item popping in.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Tonal UI Blip 02
sounds.desc: A soft, mid-pitched tonal blip with a quick decay. Use it for bullet points stacking in or a gentle button confirm.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Tonal UI Blip 03
sounds.desc: A higher-pitched, short tonal ping-blip. Use it for a quick confirm, a stat chip appearing or an ascending list sequence.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Tonal UI Blip 04
sounds.desc: A mid-pitched tonal blip with a slightly wide stereo image and a 200 ms decay. Use it for list items stacking in or a soft confirm.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Woop Click 01
sounds.desc: Short bright 'woop' click with a quick pitch sweep and no tail; use when a text box, icon or list item pops in.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Digital Tonal Blip 05
sounds.desc: A very bright, steady 90 ms digital beep; use for list items or a HUD label popping on.

sounds.name: Digital Tonal Blip 06
sounds.desc: A piercing, very high pure 85 ms beep; use sparingly for a sharp highlight on a caption keyword.

sounds.name: Low Tonal Blip 02
sounds.desc: A quiet, deep tonal thump-blip with a short decay. Use it for a toggle-off, a low list accent or a soft drop of a card.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Pep Blip 01
sounds.desc: A short bouncy synth blip; use when a text box, bullet or icon pops in during a playful edit.

sounds.name: Pep Blip 02
sounds.desc: A quick, snappy synth blip under half a second; use on a caption keyword or icon pop in a playful edit.

sounds.name: Pep Blip 03
sounds.desc: A slightly brighter bouncy synth blip; use when a sticker, emoji or bullet appears in a playful edit.

sounds.name: Pong Blip 01
sounds.desc: Quiet, short mid-pitched tonal 'pong' blip; use for list items stacking in or a small icon popping up.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Tonal UI Blip 05
sounds.desc: A quieter, mid-low tonal blip with a quick swell and a tail that runs to the end of the file. Good for a soft list-item or caption-keyword accent.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Wood Block Tock 01
sounds.desc: A brighter wood block tock whose loudest hit lands at about 85 ms (possibly a double hit), ringing for under half a second; use for playful list items.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Woop Click 02
sounds.desc: The same 'woop' click with a delay echo trailing to about 0.5 s; use for an icon popping in where a little space helps.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited
